description: Public Transport - Location Facilities and Operators is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. Operator contact details and location facilities for train stations, ferry wharves and bus interchanges. Gateway API is provided for legacy applications, this data is no longer updated and API will be retired in the the near future. To use these resources in your application please follow the CKAN api instructions in the resource description. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are api, buses, facilities, facility, ferries. It offers 3 resource(s) in API, CSV. The portal shows 2025-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
